name: senderscope
description: MCP connector for Senderscope: reverse email lookup, work-email finder and email verification for B2B.
long_description: Reverse email lookup for B2B in your AI assistant: the professional profile behind a work email (name, title, company, LinkedIn), a work-email finder by name and domain or LinkedIn, and email verification. Lookups use your Senderscope credits, one per result found. get_account reads your plan and credits. lookup_email returns the professional profile and deliverability behind a work email; find_email finds a work email from a name and company domain or a LinkedIn URL; verify_email checks deliverability, accept-all, SPF and DMARC. Each uses one credit only when it returns a result. list_lookups and get_lookup read your history for free.
